tools.name: classify_urgency
tools.description: Classify caller urgency from structured triage signals (gas/CO, extreme temp + vulnerable, maintenance, standard).

tools.name: escalate_emergency
tools.description: Life-safety escalation for gas smell or CO. Instructs evacuate + 911. Never books a technician.

tools.name: flag_priority
tools.description: Flag a high-priority ticket (e.g. no heat + vulnerable), assign John/Paul/George to the soonest open 2-hour slot, and return spoken_confirmation.

slot_start.description: Optional ISO slot start from check_availability

tools.name: mock_schedule
tools.description: Book a standard/low-priority appointment with John, Paul, or George. Locks a 2-hour slot. Pass slot_start from check_availability when the caller picks a time. Returns technician + spoken_confirmation (e.g. 'Paul will visit Thursday at 2pm — confirmation SA-…').

slot_start.description: ISO slot start chosen from check_availability.options

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Return open 2-hour appointment slots (Mon–Sat 8am–6pm America/Denver) where at least one of John, Paul, or George is free. High urgency returns earlier slots.
